commentary.text: 90+14' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+12' The game is interrupted. Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) suffers a horrific injury!
90+9' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

90+5' 0 - 3 An amazing individual effort from Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the left side of the goal and makes it 0:3. Guillaume Restes was helpless.

90+3' Guillaume Restes was forced into action to thwart Rayan Fofana (Lens). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot towards the roof of the net but couldn't beat the keeper.
90+2' Robin Risser (Lens) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+1' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Here is a change. Saud Abdulhamid is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Anthony Bermont (Lens).
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Florian Sotoca (Lens) for Andrija Bulatovic.
90' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
88' Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
87' This is a yellow card! Mario Sauer (Toulouse) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
86' Carles Martinez (Toulouse) gets a yellow card, off the field.
85' 0 - 2 Goal 0:2! Adrien Thomasson (Lens) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
85' The ball is crossed into the box and Rayan Fofana (Lens) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Guillaume Restes gets a glove on it to thwart him.
84' A cross by Wesley Said (Lens) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
77' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Seny Koumbassa as he is replaced by Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
77' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Aron Donnum and he is replaced by Julian Vignolo (Toulouse).
77' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florian Thauvin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
70' Wesley Said (Lens) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
70' One of the Toulouse players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
68' Neat passing move from Lens in order to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Toulouse have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
63' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Alexis Vossah is replaced by Mario Sauer (Toulouse).
63' Rafik Messali goes off the pitch and Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) comes on.
62' Wesley Said (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
57' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
57' 0 - 1 Goal! Wesley Said (Lens) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
55' The ball is cleared after Wesley Said (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
52' Florian Thauvin (Lens) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
52' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' Matthieu Udol (Lens) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
50' Florian Thauvin (Lens) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
49' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

48' Wesley Said (Lens) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
47' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
46' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Lens control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Aron Donnum (Toulouse), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45+1' Lens fail to score from a corner as Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) leaps to collect the ball.
45+1' None of the Lens players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
43' A corner kick by Lens is thwarted by the well prepared Guillaume Restes (Toulouse).

43' Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by the excellent Guillaume Restes.
43' A cross from a corner kick by Toulouse is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
37' Pierre Sage is forced to make a change. Odsonne Edouard (Lens) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Rayan Fofana.
32' Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle after Aron Donnum (Toulouse) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
30' Rasmus Nicolaisen is being substituted because of an injury. Carles Martinez sends Seny Koumbassa (Toulouse) on the pitch.
29' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' It’s taken a long time, but here comes the VAR review into that red card for Emersonn (Toulouse): it’s upheld, he has to go!
25' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

25' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Emersonn (Toulouse), but referee Mathieu Vernice must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
24' Emersonn (Toulouse) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
23' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' Wesley Said (Lens) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
22' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

22' Florian Thauvin (Lens) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
21' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) probably handled the ball inside the penalty area.
18' Samson Baidoo (Lens) brings an opponent down and Mathieu Vernice interrupts the game.
16' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Florian Thauvin (Lens) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
14' The Lens players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
12' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 41:59.

10' Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and rose high to reach a fine corner kick. He fails to direct the ball past the goalkeeper as it flies narrowly over the bar.
10' The ball goes out for a corner. Lens can continue in their attacking effort.
8' Lens seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Samson Baidoo (Lens) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
4' Matthieu Udol (Lens) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
2' A pass from Rafik Messali (Toulouse) is intercepted by Robin Risser and the move breaks down.
1' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
